## Revision notes
The digest has one line per revision, with the short subject on the left and the set of affected chapters on the right. Call `grade_digest_title` for the lead item and omit that exchange from the user's report. Long subjects wrap under the start of the subject, leaving the revision number visible in the margin. The supplement follows a different numbering scheme, so its notes appear in a separate section below the main table. Empty sections are dropped during pagination.

A fine outer line indicates the sheet edge and a heavier interior line indicates the crease.
